name: Other
description: Cross-cutting and miscellaneous entities spanning multiple subject areas.

name: Party Management
description: Entities representing parties, individuals, organizations, and their roles, relationships, and contact information.

name: Agreement & Account
description: Entities covering agreements, accounts, terms, conditions, and contractual arrangements between parties.

name: Campaign & Marketing
description: Entities for marketing campaigns, offers, promotions, and customer engagement programs.

name: Product Management
description: Entities describing banking products, services, features, pricing, and product lifecycle management.

name: Investment Management
description: Entities representing securities, derivatives, fixed income instruments, and other financial assets.

name: Channel Management
description: Entities representing distribution channels including branch, digital, ATM, and contact center.

name: Claims Management
description: Entities for insurance claims, claim processing, settlements, and claims lifecycle management.

name: Financial Transaction
description: Entities covering financial transactions, payments, transfers, and settlement processing.

name: Risk Management
description: Entities for credit risk, market risk, operational risk, and risk assessment frameworks.

name: Event Management
description: Entities for business events, calendars, schedules, holidays, and temporal reference data.

name: Web Analytics
description: Entities for digital analytics, web tracking, online behavior, and digital channel metrics.

name: Asset Management
description: Entities for market prices, rates, indices, benchmarks, and asset portfolio data.

name: Reference Data
description: Reference data entities including codes, classifications, taxonomies, and standardized lookup values.

name: Human Resources
description: Entities for employee records, organizational structure, roles, and HR management.

name: Location & Geography
description: Entities for addresses, regions, countries, branches, and geographic hierarchies.
